name: codex-orchestration
description: Orchestrate visible Codex tasks with explicit model routing, bounded ownership, and quiet durable results.

interface.longDescription: Use one coordinator to plan and govern multiple user-visible Codex executor tasks with explicit model routing, bounded ownership, quiet durable results, audited integration, clean unplug, and bounded release refresh for long-lived coordinators.
defaultPrompt: Plan this work across separate executor tasks with deliberate model routing.
Run this workflow with one coordinator and explicitly selected executor models.
Review and integrate the journaled task results.
Refresh this long-lived coordinator onto the loaded plugin release.
Unplug Codex Flow cleanly from this repository.
